body.p: Attorney Docket No. 4015-11847 Client Docket No. P080386US01 REMARKS

The foregoing claim amendments are submitted prior to examination on the merits. The amendments cancel claims 1-32, and add new claims 33-52. New claims 33-52 are similar to now canceled claims 1-32, but are written to eliminate multiple dependent claims, and to better comport the language of the claims with U.S. practice. No new matter has been added, and the amendments are not submitted for reasons related to patentability over any prior art.
Entry of the amendments is requested prior to examination on the merits.
